idea: AI is already inside the music people love, at every layer. Asking whether a song is AI music or human music is already the wrong question.
flow: Cold open: talking head over Imael Angel's two songs from the inspiration board, Movin' To The Sun and Bad Times, the ones people have already danced to.
The surprise: Imael Angel is an AI-generated singer. HUGEL, a human DJ, remixed Movin' To The Sun and it went into the charts; Bad Times was re-sung by humans and licensed to Universal.
The layers: AI is in the writing, the demo, the vocal, the production and what gets recommended, so you cannot hear where the human stops.
Why the binary is useless: AI is entering the mainstream fast and is becoming how humans create, so comparing the two to see who is better misses it.
Close: the viewer realises the music they love is already both.
ending: The song you can't stop dancing to is already both, and that's how music gets made now.
takeaway: People think differently: AI is infiltrating everything at every layer, and AI versus human is no longer a useful question.
angle: Surprise and enjoyment, not advice: this piece has no 3 things you can do.
tone: Playful and surprising, music first, then his usual face-with-proof format.
